# Sparkbot and Arc Request Metadata Fixtures

These fixtures are synthetic, redacted, and non-executing. They exist only to
prove that future Sparkbot-shaped and Arc-shaped normalized metadata can be
mapped into the current `KernelRequest` contract and evaluated by `LimaKernel`
as dry-run results.

They are not public Sparkbot integration, Arc Bot integration, HumanInput
runtime input, IntentEnvelope runtime records, Guardian authority, provider
routing, tool execution, connector access, persistence, live discovery, Robo-OS
access, device control, robotics, drones, or physical-world behavior.
